// State: authority[32], root[32], phase/nonce/cursor/acc[8 each], digest[32],
// scratch[64], instruction count[8], credits[8], reserved[48].
func Process(c solana.Context) uint64 {

    if tag==0 {

        copy32(s,32,s,128);store(s,64,1);store(s,80,0);store(s,88,seed)
    } else if tag==1 {
        if phase!=1 {return 203}
        if cursor!=load(s,80) || cursor>256 || count==0 || count>load(cfg,32) || count>256-cursor {return 205}
        fee:=count*load(cfg,48)
        if load(s,200)<fee {return 206}
        if solana.SHA256(c,data,0,2048,s,128)!=0 {return 210}
        if !same(s,128,s,32) {return 204}

        if cursor+count==256 {store(s,64,2)}

        if tag==3 && phase!=2 {return 203}

func load(s []byte,o uint64) uint64 {v:=uint64(0);for i:=uint64(0);i<8;i++ {v=v|uint64(s[o+i])<<(i*8)};return v}
func store(s []byte,o,v uint64) {for i:=uint64(0);i<8;i++ {s[o+i]=byte(v>>(i*8))}}
func same(a []byte,ao uint64,b []byte,bo uint64)bool {return ((load(a,ao)^load(b,bo))|(load(a,ao+8)^load(b,bo+8))|(load(a,ao+16)^load(b,bo+16))|(load(a,ao+24)^load(b,bo+24)))==0}
// Internal fixed-width helpers are called only after region validation.
// Copies use disjoint regions, including within the same state account.
func copy32(a []byte,ao uint64,b []byte,bo uint64) {store(a,ao,load(b,bo));store(a,ao+8,load(b,bo+8));store(a,ao+16,load(b,bo+16));store(a,ao+24,load(b,bo+24))}
func zero32(s []byte,o uint64) {store(s,o,0);store(s,o+8,0);store(s,o+16,0);store(s,o+24,0)}
